_doc: An entry does NOT silence a finding: it records that a human/agent reviewed the site
and why it is not surrogate evidence. Matched sites stay in the JSON report as
declared=true / allowlisted=true with the reason, so the decision is auditable.
Keys are (path, target, kind) so the entry survives unrelated line shifts.
Anything not listed here fails the gate (exit 1) when it is SEV1/SEV2.

entries.reason: value read back from the DEM tilt run (result['theta_c_deg']); the analytic/reference quantities in the same scope are the comparison target, not the source
axial bond force read from the solver run dict (run['axial_bond_force_N']); the closed form in scope is the analytic reference
closure deficit between the solver work ledger and the analytic quadrature; the analytic term is the cross-check operand, not a stand-in for the measured side
same deficit definition as the script above: solver work minus analytic quadrature

restitution recovered from the collision object's own validated history (analytic dict = the solver's recorded state), compared against its own input value; a self-consistency unit test, not an external benchmark

calibrate_alpha -> reference_restitution round-trip: a unit test of the numerical inversion (root find), circular by construction and deliberately so; it must never be cited as evidence of experimental agreement
log-decrement damping ratio measured from the simulated free-decay trajectory (traj.t/traj.y)
heave period measured from the simulated trajectory's upward crossings
running maximum of the geometric direction error over sampled segments; no analytic source
stiffness obtained from the lattice solver's strain-energy evaluation after calibration
